suiteId.description: A stable, unique identifier for this suite (not shown to users).

mainAppId.description: The bundled/full-suite app's own catalog id (source:appId), e.g. "flatpak-flathub:org.libreoffice.LibreOffice".

name.description: The component's display name, e.g. "LibreOffice Writer".

components.description: Every independently-installable component of this suite.

reason.description: How this was verified — required so the grouping is auditable later, not just an unexplained line.

title: Enrich: software suites
description: Software suites (a bundled "main" app plus separately installable "component" apps — e.g. LibreOffice/Writer/Calc/...) that aren't a single-app matching decision, so don't fit filter/match's override shapes. Deliberately not auto-detected from names — curated by hand and narrow rather than pattern-matched.
